title: Skate 2
shortDescription: Rebuilt New San Vanelona introducing the ability to get off the board to move street obstacles with the Flickit dual-stick system.
historicalSignificance: The definitive peak of analog stick physics skateboarding, delivering unmatched organic street satisfaction.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
